title: Horned Figure in Cosmic Bloom
description: A surreal black and white line-art illustration of a large horned, crowned figure with multiple arms and an open mouth filled with teeth, centered within a dark void. The figure is surrounded by vibrant, overlapping colorful bokeh circles in red, blue, yellow, and purple, with abstract ink splatters, leaves, and floating doodles in the white upper portion.
prompt: Surreal black and white ink illustration of a giant horned and crowned demonic figure with multiple arms and gaping mouth, emerging from a dark circular void. The figure is framed by dense overlapping colorful bokeh orbs in red blue yellow purple, with abstract ink splatters, floating leaves, doodles and line art elements in the white space above, chaotic mystical atmosphere, detailed linework
